text:
morgan: Heads-up - we're still seeing inconsistent client messages for quota vs routing fallbacks. Can we nail down a small lexicon and a short runbook? My proposal below.

claire: +1 need to avoid 'internal error' for stuff that's retryable. Example: we return 503 + 'temporarily overloaded' but console shows 'request failed' — customer confusion.

raj: Quick note: quotas can be transient (burst) or sustained. Suggest 429 with subcode for quota_burst vs quota_cap. Then client can decide backoff vs abort.

morgan: Proposed mapping (prototype):
```json
{
  "error_code": "quota_burst",
  "http_status": 429,
  "client_hint": "retry-after,reduce-rate",
  "severity": "transient",
  "console_badge": "throttle"
}
```

claire: For routing fallback (we routed to cheaper model) we currently return 200 but add header `X-Model-Used`. Customers complained when quality dropped. Prefer a clearer signal.

jen: I think avoid 200 when fallback degrades quality. Prefer 503 with body that includes `fallback_used: true`, `quality_degraded: true`, and `fallback_model`. Then console can badge as 'degraded' and show opt-out.

raj: Telemetry needs consistent tags: `error.bucket`, `error.retryable` (true/false), `route.policy`, and `fallback_model`. Console should show per-tenant timeline: first fallback -> percent degraded responses over last 24h.

deploy-bot: deploy: scheduling canary rollout of new status mapping to 10% of traffic in staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

morgan: Short runbook draft:
1) 429 + `quota_burst` -> user-facing: 'Rate limit exceeded; please retry after Xs' and include `Retry-After` header.
2) 429 + `quota_cap` -> user-facing: 'Quota exhausted; upgrade or contact support' and console call-to-action.
3) 503 + `fallback_quality_degraded` -> user-facing: 'We served a lower-quality model to keep latency/costs stable. Toggle fallback in Console to opt out.' (provide `fallback_model` field).
4) 5xx infra -> user-facing: 'Service temporarily unavailable; we are investigating' + incident link when available.

Also add SDK mapping: exception classes with `.retryable`, `.quota_type`, and `.fallback_used` fields so apps can programmatically choose backoff vs abort.

claire: Can we also include a tiny example response schema so integrators can parse easily?

morgan: Example response body suggestion:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "quota_cap",
    "http_status": 429,
    "message": "Quota exhausted",
    "retryable": false,
    "hint": "upgrade or contact support",
    "console_actions": ["upgrade_link"]
  }
}
```

jen: I'll draft the console badge copy and wire the UX flag for 'suppress fallback notifications' per tenant. Assigning to @jen.

raj: +1 on SDK helpers; I'll add telemetry schema and a quick aggregation query for the dashboard (count by error.bucket, sum by tenant).

morgan: Thanks all — I'll collate into a short RFC with examples and a rollout plan. Will ping PM and infra. :thumbsup:
